newsitem.title: USA: Raleigh, N.C., plans $45 mln GO bond referendum.
newsitem.headline: Raleigh, N.C., plans $45 mln GO bond referendum.

text.p: North Carolina's Raleigh City Council has tentatively endorsed a May referendum on a general obligation bond issue of about $45 million for road projects, the News & Observer said Wednesday.

Final approval is expected early next year, after the commission picks specific road projects and sets the final amount for the bonds, the newspaper said. Council members are reviewing nine road-widening projects, most of them in rapidly growing North Raleigh.
The referendum is expected to go on the ballot for the May 5 primary election.
